mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% in the latest monthly reading, it indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that precedes economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-employment regimes, a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of high-employment periods when PAYEMS declines, or regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening causing economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
